dimensionalchaos.hub.guide.page1:
Welcome to Dimensional Chaos - OneBlock!

You start on a single block in the void. Mine it, grow your island and complete the quests to push its border back.
dimensionalchaos.hub.guide.page2:
Rules

- Be respectful
- No cheating, exploits or griefing
- No advertising
- Staff decisions are final

Have fun!
dimensionalchaos.hub.guide.page3: Join the community: news, help, suggestions and bug reports.

dimensionalchaos.hub.guide.page4:
Store

Permanent ranks and cosmetics that support the server. No gameplay advantage: everything you buy is for looks or recognition.
